concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 8 History ke Chapter 3 — व्यापार से साम्राज्य तक — padhenge. Is chapter mein dikhaya gaya hai ki aurangzeb ke baad Mughal shakti kaise kamzor hui, aur East India Company pehle sirf ek chhoti trading company thi. Phir Bengal mein factory, farman, Plassey, Buxar aur Diwani ke zariye woh kaise trade se territory tak pahunchi — Residents aur Subsidiary Alliance ke saath.
concept_map.welcome: Good morning, class! Aaj Smart Board par ek bahut important story shuru karte hain — व्यापार से साम्राज्य तक. Socho: ek company pehle kapda, mirch aur elaichi kharidne aayi thi… aur ek din usi company ne poore Bengal ka revenue control kar liya! Kaise hua yeh badlav? Aaj hum wahi journey samjhenge — step by step, classroom style. Ready ho? Chalo blackboard ki taraf!
learning_outcomes: Aurangzeb ke baad Mughal power ke kamzor hone aur regional riyasaton ke uday ko explain karna
1600 ke charter se East India Company ke aane aur European companies ki competition ko samajhna
Bengal mein factory, farman, Nawabs ke saath conflict, Plassey aur Buxar ke results batana
Diwani, puppet Nawabs, ‘Nabobs’, Residents aur Subsidiary Alliance se Company rule expand hone ko link karna

generated.concept: मुग़ल शक्ति का पतन और अंग्रेज़ों का उदय
generated.say: Bacchon, chapter shuru karte hain ek bade sawaal se. Mughal badshahon mein Aurangzeb aakhiri shaktishali badshah the. Unhone vartaman Bharat ke ek bahut bade hisse par control sthapit kar liya tha. Lekin 1707 mein unki mrityu ke baad bahut saare Mughal subedars aur bade-bade zamindar apni taakat dikhane lage. Unhone apni kshetriya riyasatein kaayam kar liin. Jaise-jaise vividh bhagon mein taakatwar kshetriya riyasatein saamne aane lagiin, Delhi adhik dinon tak prabhavi kendra ke roop mein nahi rah saki. Ab important turn: atharahvin sadi ke uttarardh tak political horizon par Angrezon ke roop mein ek nayi taakat ubharne lagi thi. Kya aap jaante hain ki Angrez pehle-pahal ek chhoti-si vyaparik company ke roop mein Bharat aaye the, aur yahaan ke ilakon par kabze mein unki zyada dilchaspi nahi thi? Toh phir aisa kaise hua ki ek din ve is vishal samrajya ke swami ban baithe? Isi chapter mein hum dekhenge ki yeh kaise hua. Ek aur baat yaad rakho — Aurangzeb ke baad koi Mughal badshah itna taakatwar nahi hua, lekin ek prateek ke roop mein Mughal badshahon ka mahatva bana raha. Jab 1857 mein British shasan ke viruddha bhari vidroh shuru hua, toh vidrohiyon ne Mughal badshah Bahadur Shah Zafar ko hi apna neta maan liya. Jab vidroh kuchal diya gaya, toh Company ne Bahadur Shah Zafar ko desh chhodne ke liye majboor kar diya aur unke beton ko Zafar ke saamne hi maar daala. Pehla idea clear: Mughal centre kamzor → regional powers ↑ → Angrez nayi force.
generated.example: School mein principal ke jaane ke baad agar har class teacher alag-alag rules chalaane lage, toh school ka centre kamzor ho jaata hai — bilkul jaise Delhi ke baad regional riyasatein strong ho gayiin.

worked_example.problem: ‘Aurangzeb ke baad Mughal badshahon ka koi mahatva nahi raha.’ Sahi ya galat? Reason do.
steps: Source recall: koi badshah Aurangzeb jitna taakatwar nahi hua
Lekin prateek ke roop mein Mughal badshah mahatvapurna rahe
1857 mein vidrohiyon ne Bahadur Shah Zafar ko neta maana — isliye statement galat
worked_example.answer: Galat. Power kam thi, lekin Mughal badshah prateek ke roop mein important rahe; 1857 mein Bahadur Shah Zafar ko neta maana gaya.

generated.concept: पूर्व में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी का आना
generated.say: Ab section — पूर्व में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी का आना. San 1600 mein East India Company ne England ki maharani Elizabeth I se charter yani ijazatnama haasil kar liya. Isse Company ko poorab se vyapar karne ka ekadhikar mil gaya. Matlab: England ki koi aur vyaparik company is ilake mein East India Company se hod nahi kar sakti thi. Is charter ke sahare Company samudra paar jakar naye ilakon ko khangaal sakti thi, wahan se sasti keemat par cheezein kharid kar unhein Europe mein oonchi keemat par bech sakti thi. Company ko doosri Angrezi companies se pratispardha ka koi bhay nahi tha. Us zamane mein vanijyik companies pratispardha se bachkar hi munafa kama sakti thiin. Lekin yeh shahi dastavez doosri European taakaton ko poorab ke bazaaron mein aane se nahi rok sakta tha. Jab tak England ke jahaaz Africa ke pashchim tat ko chhoote hue Cape of Good Hope ka chakkar lagaakar Hind Mahasagar paar karte, tab tak Portuguese ne Bharat ke pashchimi tat par apni upasthiti darj kara di thi. Ve Goa mein apna thikana bana chuke the. Portugal ke khoji yatri Vasco da Gama ne 1498 mein pehli baar Bharat tak pahunchne ke is samudri marg ka pata lagaya tha. Satrahvin shatabdi ki shuruaat tak Dutch bhi Hind Mahasagar mein vyapar ki sambhavnayein talashne lage the. Kuch hi samay baad French vyapari bhi saamne aa gaye. Board tip: Charter = monopoly only against other English traders, not against Portuguese/Dutch/French.
generated.example: School canteen mein agar sirf ek student ko chip packets bechne ka monopoly mile — doosre students nahi bech sakte — lekin bahar se koi aur dukaan aa sakti hai. Bilkul jaise Company ka charter sirf English rivals rokta tha.
board_lines: 1600: Queen Elizabeth I → Charter / ijazatnama to EIC
Charter = English monopoly for Eastern trade (not against other Europeans)
Portuguese (Goa; Vasco da Gama 1498) → then Dutch → then French
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain 1600 ke charter ne saari duniya ki companies ko rok diya — galat. Yeh sirf England ki doosri companies ko rokta tha; Portuguese, Dutch, French aaye.
generated.memory_trick: C-P-D-F: Charter 1600 → Portuguese first → Dutch → French.
generated.gesture_action: Ek student ko ‘Queen’ banao jo ‘charter paper’ de; doosre students Portuguese/Dutch/French banakar alag taraf se aayein — dikhao ki charter unhe nahi rokta.

worked_example.problem: East India Company ko 1600 mein kya mila, aur iska matlab kya tha? Doosri European powers isse kaise affect nahi huiin?
steps: 1600 mein Queen Elizabeth I se charter/ijazatnama mila

Lekin yeh document Portuguese, Dutch, French ko nahi rok sakta tha
worked_example.answer: Company ko Eastern trade ka English monopoly mila; doosri European taakatein is charter se bound nahi thiin, isliye Portuguese (Goa), Dutch aur French aaye.

generated.concept: यूरोपीय कंपनियों की प्रतिस्पर्धा और हथियारों वाला व्यापार
generated.say: Ab sabse interesting tension — competition. Samasya yeh thi ki saari companies ek jaisi cheezein hi kharidna chahti thiin. Europe ke bazaaron mein Bharat ke bane baarik sooti kapde aur resham ki zabardast maang thi. Inke alawa kali mirch, long, elaichi aur dalchini ki bhi zabardast maang rahti thi. European companies ke beech is badhti pratispardha se Bharatiya bazaaron mein in cheezon ki keematein badhne lagiin aur unse milne wala munafa girne laga. Ab in vyaparik companies ke phalne-phoolne ka yahi ek raasta tha ki ve apni pratispardhi companies ko khatam kar dein. Lihaza, bazaaron par kabze ki is hod ne vyaparik companies ke beech ladaiyon ki shuruaat kar di. Satrahvin aur atharahvin sadi mein jab bhi mauka milta, koi-si ek company kisi doosri company ke jahaaz doobo deti, raaste mein rukavatein khadi kar deti, aur maal se lade jahaazon ko aage badhne se rok deti. Yeh vyapar hathiyaron ki madad se chal raha tha aur vyaparik chowkiyon ko kilebandi ke zariye surakshit rakha jaata tha. Apni bastiyon ko kileband karne aur vyapar mein munafa kamane ki in koshishon ke kaaran sthaniya shasakhon se bhi takrav hone lage. Is prakar, vyapar aur rajniti ko ek-doosre se alag rakhna Company ke liye mushkil hota ja raha tha. Yaad rakho keyword: vanijyik — aisa vyavasayik udyam jismein cheezein sasti keemat par kharidkar aur zyada keemat par bechkar, yani mukhya roop se vyapar ke zariye munafa kamaya jaata hai. Jab trade + guns + forts mil gaye, politics door nahi rahi.
generated.example: Do ice-cream sellers ek hi gali mein same flavour bechein toh price war hoti hai; agar dono force use karke ek doosre ko hataayein — trade fight mein badal jaati hai. European companies mein yahi hua.
board_lines: Demand: fine cotton, silk, pepper, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon
Competition ↑ → Indian prices ↑ → European profits ↓
Solution tried: eliminate rivals → armed trade + fortified posts → clash with local rulers
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain companies sirf shanti se trade karti thiin — source clearly kehta hai trade hathiyaron ki madad se chal raha tha aur chowkiyan kileband thiin.
generated.memory_trick: T-F-F: Trade + Forts + Fight. Competition ne trade ko armed fight bana diya.
generated.gesture_action: Do students ko rival companies banao — pehle ‘buy cloth/spices’ act, phir haath se ‘block the ship’ gesture, phir imaginary fort walls banakar local ruler se face-off.
real_life_examples: Do wholesale shops same vegetable market mein — prices up for farmers’ goods if both fight for stock
School fair stalls same item bechein toh rivalry badhti hai; rules todna = conflict

worked_example.problem: European companies ke beech competition badhne se munafa kyun girne laga? Aur companies ne kya raasta apnaya?
steps: Sab companies same goods (cloth, silk, spices) kharidna chahti thiin
Demand pressure se Indian market prices badhe → profits gire
Companies ne rivals ko khatam karne, ships sink/block karne, forts banane ka raasta apnaya
worked_example.answer: Same goods ki hod se prices badhe aur profit gira; companies ne armed competition aur fortified trading posts se rivals hatane ki koshish ki, jisse local rulers se bhi clash hua.

generated.concept: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी बंगाल में व्यापार शुरू करती है
generated.say: Ab dekhte hain Bengal story. Pehli English factory 1651 mein Hugli nadi ke kinare shuru hui. Company ke vyapari yahin se apna kaam chalate the. In vyapariyon ko us zamane mein ‘factor’ kaha jaata tha. Is factory mein warehouse tha jahaan niryat hone wali cheezein jama ki jaati thiin. Yahin par uske daftar the jinmein Company ke afsar baithte the. Jaise-jaise vyapar phaila, Company ne saudagaron aur vyapariyon ko factory ke aaspaas aakar basne ke liye prerit kiya. 1696 tak Company ne is aabadi ke charon taraf ek kila banana shuru kar diya tha. Do saal baad usne Mughal afsaron ko rishwat dekar teen gaavon ki zamindari bhi kharid li. Inmein se ek gaon Kalikata tha jo baad mein Calcutta bana — ab Kolkata kaha jaata hai. Company ne Mughal samrat Aurangzeb ko is baat ke liye bhi taiyar kar liya ki woh Company ko bina shulk chukaaye vyapar karne ka farman jaari kar de. Farman matlab ek shahi aadesh. Company zyada se zyada riyayatein haasil karne aur pehle se maujood adhikaron ka zyada se zyada fayda uthane mein lagi hui thi. Example: Aurangzeb ke farman se keval Company ko hi shulk-mukt vyapar ka adhikar mila tha. Company ke jo afsar private trade chalate, unhein yeh chhoot nahi thi. Lekin unhone bhi shulk chukane se inkaar kar diya. Isse Bengal mein rajswa wasooli bahut kam ho gayi. Aise mein bhala Bengal ke Nawab Murshid Quli Khan virodh kyun na karte? Clear lesson: trade concession → misuse by private officers → Nawab angry.
generated.example: School mein agar team ko free bus pass mile, lekin team ke friends bhi bina ticket ghumne lagen — school fees collection gir jaaye; principal naraz hoga. Farman misuse bilkul aisa hi tha.

worked_example.answer: Kyunki farman ka fayda private officers ne galat uthaya, shulk nahi diya, Bengal revenue gir gaya — isliye Murshid Quli Khan virodh karne lage.

generated.say: Section — व्यापार से युद्धों तक. Atharahvin sadi ki shuruaat mein Company aur Bengal ke Nawabs ka takrav kaafi badh gaya tha. Company ko is baat ka bhi yakeen tha ki apna vyapar phailane ke liye use apni aabadi badhani hogi, gaon kharidne honge aur kilon ka punarnirman karna hoga. Yeh takrav dinodin gambhir hote gaye; antatah in takravon ki parinati Plassey ke prasiddh yuddh ke roop mein hui. generated.say: Ab famous battle — प्लासी का युद्ध. 1756 mein Ali Vardi Khan ki mrityu ke baad Sirajuddaulah Bengal ke Nawab bane. Company ko Sirajuddaulah ki taakat se kaafi bhay tha. Company ek aisa kathputli Nawab chahti thi jo use vyaparik riyayatein aur suvidhayein aasani se de. Usne Sirajuddaulah ke pratidwandwiyon mein se kisi ko Nawab banane ki koshish ki, lekin kaamyabi nahi mili. Jawab mein Sirajuddaulah ne hukum diya ki Company political mamalon mein taang adana band kare, kilebandi roke aur baqayda rajswa chukaaye. Jab dono paksh peeche nahi hate, toh apne 30,000 sipahiyon ke saath Nawab ne Kasim Bazar ki English factory par hamla bol diya — afsar giraftar, godam band, hathiyar chheen liye, jahaaz gher liye. Phir Calcutta ke kile par kabza kiya. Yeh khabar sunte hi Madras se Robert Clive ke netritva mein Company sena rawana hui; naval fleet ki madad bhi mili.
